scope.description: Synthetic prior assessment for before/after dashboard testing.

findings.title: Primary account does not use MFA
findings.recommendation: Enable strong MFA, review active sessions, and confirm recovery methods.

findings.title: Profile shares more personal detail than necessary
findings.recommendation: Review audience settings and remove details that are not needed publicly.

findings.title: No agreed trusted escalation contact
findings.recommendation: Agree on a trusted contact and review how to use platform safety and reporting tools.
